description: Groups the up-to-4 stock Sales Invoice documents assembled from ONE posted Reconciliation Run (D8 four-way split). Carries the naming gate, the external client-approval axis, and the SoD preparer/approver pair. Amounts are never stored here; they live on the emitted stock Sales Invoices.

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for a client-wide assembly run.
fields.label: Branch Site

fields.description: The billing cycle this run invoices.
fields.label: Timesheet Period

fields.description: Assembly version for this client/branch/period; a re-run is a new version.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: The POSTED Reconciliation Run that is the ONLY source of the billed amounts (P-190). Every emitted Sales Invoice line traces back through it.
fields.label: Reconciliation Run

fields.description: Engine-written summary of the enabled component subset this client receives (source of truth is Component Routing Rule).
fields.label: Present Set

fields.description: How many of the up-to-4 documents this run should produce.
fields.label: Documents Expected

fields.description: 1 = the sum of the pre-VAT subtotals equals the run's total Billable.
fields.label: Reconciles To Run

fields.description: The built legal name + VAT must match the Client Name Registry before issue; a mismatch holds the run.
fields.label: Naming Status

fields.description: External approval axis. A VAT-applied SAMPLE carries no SINV number or ZATCA stamp; written client approval is captured free-text (no keyword matching).
fields.label: Client Approval Status

fields.description: Free-text capture of the client's written approval. No keyword matching is performed on this field.
fields.label: Client Approval Message Ref

fields.description: Optional ad-hoc client cutoff, distinct from any system SLA.
fields.label: Client Requested Deadline

fields.description: Number of SAMPLE / REVISED-SAMPLE rounds. Each round is an Audit Event, not a separate log; a round never consumes a SINV / ZATCA number.
fields.label: Sample Round Count

fields.description: Assembler of the run. Must differ from the approver / issuer (SoD).
fields.label: Prepared By

fields.description: Lifecycle state (integrator-seeded Workflow rides this field).
fields.label: Status
